restaurant: ONE STOP ROTI SHOP AND BAKERY, INC.
assessment: Reviewed the desktop storefront after building and refining it. I designed a warm, bakery-inspired editorial layout using serif typography and spice-toned gradients to match the restaurant’s Indian roti shop and bakery menu. The homepage leads with a bold text-only hero, immediate order actions, address/phone/hours in a side panel, quick section links, and a sticky navigation with persistent cart access. I rendered the full menu in the supplied section and item order with exact names, prices, descriptions where present, required data attributes, and add buttons for every item. Because no header, cover, or dish images were supplied, I used typography, spacing, cards, and color to create hierarchy rather than placeholders. After previewing, I refined the hero cart CTA wording and the menu intro/cart action so ordering feels clearer and the transition into the menu is stronger at 1280×900. The review page is branded consistently and styles the provided review markup for readability and checkout clarity.
